title: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK

[Mr Snuffleupagus] Are you sure? Better check the exclusions:
Exclusions
Orders delivered to an address outside the UK are not eligible for cashback.
[Clear] Are they finally enforcing it after adding that in months ago? My orders from August tracked.
[Mr Snuffleupagus] I last used them in June and it was fine. I don’t know when they changed the terms though. The ultimate test will be if they payout I guess.
[Clear] My July orders became claimable last week. We'll see.
[chyawala] My order from the start of June tracked. It's says payable in 11 weeks, and it's 15 weeks now and still not approved.
Only when the community here can consistently report that these are be paid out on time would it be worth using TCB UK for Ali
[poppingtags] I thought the previous wording was different and more vague - this is more explicit? I think it was something along the lines of the order needing to be delivered to the same country that the order was placed from. This seems to be specifically coming after us, as I'm sure they have a massive influx of traffic from Australia.
Either way, not worth the risk for an extra 2% unless you hit the cap. That's also leaving aside all us who who had their orders fail to track at all in the last 35% CB offer.
[bohn] It was only just added recently
First they changed it to 'Orders placed in one country and shipped to another are not eligible for cashback.' which wouldn't impact us, ordering in Australia to Australia.
Then they changed it to 'Orders delivered to an address outside the UK are not eligible for cashback.'
This was early September.
[Tehcookiemonsta] :/ i purchased something on 2nd September
[kevvy1098] @Tehcookiemonsta: same but i dont see it as an issue. the first change won't impact us unless you shipping outside of AUS. The 2nd one was a recent change
[jmc787] I wouldn't bother taking the risk for the sake of 2%. TCB AU is 23%.
[Juice08] My order incorrectly tracked from August with TCBUK
[Clear] How incorrectly? Factoring in that it'll exclude tax.
[UncleRico] In their defence, if AliExpress can't figure out how to manage the 10% GST calculation, it's probably unfair of us to expect cashback sites to do it for them… ;)
[Juice08] Not GST. Completely wrong. Well below the total and even the price of one item.
[happychild100] Yeah hard to say on this one now. Exclusion was added at the start of September then updated a few days later.
1/9/26
Orders placed in one country and shipped to another are not eligible for cashback.
5/9/26
Orders delivered to an address outside the UK are not eligible for cashback.
[Low Punt] All my orders are August and earlier so I really hope they honour them!
[Mr Discount] I have cashback pending with tcb UK. They should honor it because it was tracked on 17th august, before the new exclusions were put out.
[Ironic fear] My last confirmed cashback was 7th September. I have others pending still though, some were ordered late August and some 1st September.
I'm pretty hopeful it'll come through but also I didn't order anything big either time so it helps
[tunzafun001] Wonder if they will actually be able to track/police this. I'm wagering no.
[Clear] Pretty easy to do. They'll see the customer is in Australia and delivery country is Australia.
[HUKDRefugee] Looks like the jig is up people… It was a good run…
[Some Random Guy] GGAAHHHH! I was hoping to get an e-bike with uncapped cash back but setting as they might not honour it I'll have to wait for TCB AU to up their offering…
[freedomofspeech] I made my purchase via TCB UK. Lets see what happens.
[OzzyBrak] Unless you shipped it to a UK address you'll get no cashback
[CT30] This exclusion never existed. They have specifically added it only now. Dont risk it.
[OzzyBrak] Sorry @Clear, I love your AliExpress deals but unfortunately this cashback is no longer available to orders shipped to Australia.
[Clear] That's what the report button is for. Let the mods decide, because I can't remove the deal.
[OzzyBrak] Negative Vote
Purpose:
To let others know about issues with the deal, merchant or product.
Appropriate uses of negative vote
Issue with retailer.
The issue with this retailer is they will no longer pay cashback for AliExpress orders that aren't shipped to the UK
[Clear] Neither of us are wrong. It would seem the deal has 3 reports already so I'm sure they'll action it tomorrow.
[OzzyBrak] @Clear: You could have listed the exclusions in the deal body so that people could make their own judgement without having to read the comments.
[CheapGit] Hopefully there is another deal in October/November as I've got family coming down for Christmas so they can add some extra cargo!
[onyx981] Personally wouldn't touch TCB UK again, ordered like 20 items during the last sale and only 50% of them tracked despite all being affiliate confirmed.
It's even been even worse for recent orders in the last week. Au has been more reliable personally, ymmv I guess.
[Ash-Say] Why it is marked expired? It is still showing 25%..
[geshc] They changed the terms 2 weeks ago. If you order from outside the UK, it may track but will not pay out as defined in the new terms.
